claims.value: melanin-filled pigment granules; look: brown to black; abundance: unknown; position: unknown
claims.quote: Contains melanin-filled pigment granules, which gives a brown to black appearance.

claims.value: Melanocytes make the pigment melanin, which colors skin and hair and helps shield the living cells of the epidermis from UV radiation damage.
claims.quote: The second is a melanocyte, a cell that produces the pigment melanin. Melanin gives hair and skin its color, and also helps protect the living cells of the epidermis from ultraviolet (UV) radiation damage.

source.citation: Betts JG, Young KA, Wise JA, Johnson E, Poe B, Kruse DH, Korol O, Johnson JE, Womble M, DeSaix P (2022). Anatomy and Physiology 2e. OpenStax.

claims.value: UV exposure stimulates melanocytes to make and secrete more melanin.
claims.quote: Exposure to UV irradiation stimulates the melanocytes to produce and secrete more melanin.

source.citation: Betts JG, Young KA, Wise JA, Johnson E, Poe B, Kruse DH, Korol O, Johnson JE, Womble M, DeSaix P (2022). Anatomy and Physiology 2e. OpenStax.

claims.value: Sun-exposed keratinocytes release chemicals that stimulate melanocytes, so more melanin is made and builds up in the keratinocytes.
claims.quote: Exposure to the UV rays of the sun or a tanning salon causes melanin to be manufactured and built up in keratinocytes, as sun exposure stimulates keratinocytes to secrete chemicals that stimulate melanocytes.

source.citation: Betts JG, Young KA, Wise JA, Johnson E, Poe B, Kruse DH, Korol O, Johnson JE, Womble M, DeSaix P (2022). Anatomy and Physiology 2e. OpenStax.

claims.value: Melanocytes in the hair papilla make the melanin that colors hair.
claims.quote: hair gets its color from the pigment melanin, produced by melanocytes in the hair papilla.

source.citation: Betts JG, Young KA, Wise JA, Johnson E, Poe B, Kruse DH, Korol O, Johnson JE, Womble M, DeSaix P (2022). Anatomy and Physiology 2e. OpenStax.

claims.value: Melanocyte-stimulating hormone acts on skin melanocytes to increase their melanin production.
claims.quote: melanocyte-stimulating hormone (MSH) | stimulates melanocytes of the skin increasing melanin pigment production.

source.citation: Clark MA, Douglas M, Choi J (2018). Biology 2e. OpenStax.

tier1.text: A pigment cell derived from the neural crest. Contains melanin-filled pigment granules, which gives a brown to black appearance.
